name: positive_only_bpl_variable_natural_pairs_pilot_v1

training: bona fide only; two independently drawn groups with replacement; no waveform concatenation, no OC, CE, negative term, or centroid update
initialization: fresh backend seed 1, fixed pretrained XLS-R; no B/C warm start
selection: locked Train joint distribution policy; source and crop draws independent within and between groups; duplicate source draws are recorded

reference_selection: 256 fixed distinct Train bona fide originals sampled by the joint policy source weights, one fixed crop each
score: cosine to normalized mean of current normalized reference embeddings; recomputed per checkpoint, not learned via classification
limits: 108-step pilot, not the previous full 50-epoch run
dev subset EER is stratified diagnostic, not full official dev or target EER
RawBoost retained, so any noise improvement is not attributable to cross-utterance BPL alone
reduced noise sensitivity must be assessed alongside collapse metrics and detection scores
hypotheses: positive-only cross-utterance alignment may reduce controlled-noise sensitivity
